verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile docs claim Copilot integration—assigning issues to Copilot for PRs, natural-language Q&A about code, code review suggestions, and Agent Task tracking—which covers some conversational agent-driven actions like generating PRs and reviewing code. However, there's no evidence of full conversational control over browse/search/edit/commit/pull/push in one continuous agent-directed workflow, and no community evidence corroborates these AI features (all community feedback predates Copilot integration and focuses on basic app usability issues).
